name: Inverse Finance Anchor xINV InvFeed unvalidated Keep3r window
summary: InvFeed.latestAnswer(), the price feed Anchor's Oracle used for the xINV collateral market, called Keep3rV2Oracle.current(INV, 1e18, WETH) and discarded the lastUpdatedAgo value that function returns, applying no minimum averaging window, staleness bound or deviation bound. Because Keep3rV2OracleFactory.workForFree() is permissionless, the attacker could pump the SushiSwap INV/WETH pair and force a fresh observation in the same block, so one block later current() averaged 15 seconds of manipulated cumulative price and InvFeed reported INV at 20,926.79 USD instead of 394.23. The violated invariant is that collateral pricing used for borrow authorization must not be atomically manipulable by a market participant; the deployed feed contained no validation capable of enforcing it.

loss.notes: The four components are the exact Borrow amounts in the anchor receipt, all credited to the attack contract and forwarded to the attacker in the same transaction. Twenty-four copycat calls to the attack contract's permissionless mint() later in the same block emitted Borrow with amount 0 and added nothing. The 1,746.4378787523042 INV the attacker posted as collateral, worth about 662,938 USD at the unmanipulated DefiLlama INV price, remained with the protocol; it is an attacker-supplied input and is not netted from this gross-assets-lost figure, which would otherwise be about 14.19M USD. The attacker realised 3,979,391.769826477557748974 DAI for the borrowed DOLA in a later Curve swap, so the near-par DOLA valuation is realisable rather than a spot mark. YFI uses the last DefiLlama point at or before the anchor (1648895989); the next point, 5 seconds after the anchor, is 23,471.48 USD and would lower the total by about 1,161 USD. Widely reported figures of 15.6M USD use round contemporaneous prices; this record uses the exact quantities.

ageReset.description: InvFeed is an immutable contract with no owner, setters, proxy or delegatecall dispatch; its runtime was installed by this top-level creation and is byte-identical at block 14506358.

sources.note: Anchor: 0x600373f67521324c8068cfd025f121a0843d57ec813411661b07edc5ff781842, block 14506359 index 24, timestamp 1648897449, receipt status 0x1, 238 call frames. The trace reproduces the whole causal path: the attack contract 0xea0c959bbb7476ddd6cd4204bdee82b790aa1562 calls sync() on the SushiSwap INV/WETH pair 0x328dfd0139e26cb0fef7b0742b49b0fe4325f821, mints xINV 0x1637e4e9941d55703a7a5e7807d6ada3f7dcd61b with 1,746.4378787523042 INV, then borrows from four Anchor markets, each borrowAllowed on comptroller 0x4dcf7407ae5c07f8681e1659f626e114a7667339 (implementation 0x731b65a993c7a4ff10d304d5204afc51033cda4c) calling Oracle 0xe8929afd47064efd36a7fb51da3f8c5eb40c4cb4 getUnderlyingPrice 0xfc57d4df, which reads feeds[xINV].addr = InvFeed 0x210ac53b27f16e20a9aa7d16260f84693390258f latestAnswer() 0x50d25bcd, which calls Keep3rV2Oracle 0x39b1df026010b5aea781f90542ee19e900f2db15 current(address,uint256,address) 0xa75d39c2 on that pair. Defect, reproduced by direct eth_call at the surrounding blocks: at block 14506357 the pair held 432.085174104057173344 INV / 46.096818479249535454 WETH and current() returned 0.112998479195734210 WETH per INV with lastUpdatedAgo 501,390 s. In block 14506358 the attacker's transaction 0x20a6dcff06a791a7f8be9f423053ce8caee3f9eecc31df32445fc98d4ccd8365 swapped WETH into the pair, leaving 57.699697019214999123 INV / 346.096818479249535454 WETH, and then called the permissionless Keep3rV2OracleFactory 0xd14439b3a7245d8ea92e37b77347014ea7e4f809 workForFree() 0x399b2fb9, which appended observation 114 stamped 1648897434 carrying the pre-swap cumulative. One block later, at 14506359 timestamp 1648897449, current() divided 15 seconds of manipulated cumulative by that 15-second window and returned 5.998243255315418667 WETH per INV, and InvFeed multiplied it by the Chainlink ETH/USD answer to report 20,926.791034009538953802 USD per INV against 394.231354187661426532 the block before, a 53x inflation. Boundary test: InvFeed.latestAnswer() declares the interface 'function current(address,uint256,address) returns (uint256 amountOut, uint lastUpdatedAgo)' and discards lastUpdatedAgo entirely, applying no minimum averaging window, no staleness bound and no deviation bound before the value is used for borrow solvency. It has no owner and no setters; all four addresses are immutable constructor arguments, so there is no parameter value of the deployed contract at which it would have rejected a 15-second window. Keep3rV2Oracle.current() is not treated as the defect here because it returns the window length to its caller and its periodSize is a compile-time constant it never applies in current(); the missing check belongs to the consumer. The Anchor Oracle.setFeed(xINV, InvFeed, 18) that installed this feed is configuration context and is not the code-age anchor. Target: InvFeed 0x210ac53b27f16e20a9aa7d16260f84693390258f, direct, immutable, 1,114-byte runtime, created by top-level CREATE from Inverse's deployer 0x3fcb35a1cbfb6007f9bc638d388958bc4550cb28 in 0x49fa7c0c104dd4a907673e1920cc46c9879a96883c8ed5345bdeb7a7d2df5278 at block 12415560 index 176, timestamp 1620768865. The runtime hashes to 0xe730dc8c0bf69da72fd2068f4dd1865a4c5e1b7dcd456f5e8577cff19bbe9199 at blocks 12415560, 12415561, 13000000, 14000000 and 14506358, and prestateTracer on the anchor returns the same hash. Code age 1648897449 - 1620768865 = 28,128,584 s (325.56 days). Etherscan's verified source (ContractName InvFeed, solc v0.5.16) matches. Loss: the four Borrow events in the anchor receipt are anDOLA 0x7fcb7dac61ee35b3d4a51117a7c58d53f0a8a670 3,999,669.029654761043260989 DOLA, anETH 0x697b4acaa24430f254224eb794d2a85ba1fa1fb8 1,588.263719446159096974 ETH, anWBTC 0x17786f3813e6ba35343211bd8fe18ec4de14f28b 94.03071805 WBTC and anYFI 0xde2af899040536884e062d3a334f2dd36f34b4a4 39.368440899328442 YFI, all to borrower 0xea0c959bbb7476ddd6cd4204bdee82b790aa1562, which forwarded 1,588.263719446159096974 ETH and the tokens to 0x8b4c1083cd6aef062298e1fa900df9832c8351b3 in the same transaction. Twenty-four later transactions in the same block re-entered the attack contract's permissionless mint() and each emitted Borrow with amount 0, so no loss is double counted. No flash loan was used; the attacker funded the manipulation with roughly 500 ETH of its own. The 1,746.4378787523042 INV of collateral the protocol retained (about 662,938 USD at the DefiLlama INV price of 379.5946450931414) is an attacker-supplied input that is not deducted from this gross measure; net of it the loss is about 14.19M USD. The attacker's DOLA was sold in 0x51d6b0c9369c46e6e2a9a6e83c0d01a26b01a683852187bdff82701d1ab87ed4 for 3,979,391.769826477557748974 DAI, confirming that valuing DOLA near par is realisable. The anchor sender 0x117c0391b3483e32aa665b5ecb2cc539669ea7e9 is not the staging EOA; its seven lifetime transactions consist only of calls to two of the attacker's staged contracts and a 0.903590799 ETH transfer to 0x8b4c1083cd6aef062298e1fa900df9832c8351b3, so it is treated as attacker-side.

notes: The anchor is the borrow transaction rather than the preceding price-manipulation transaction 0x20a6dcff06a791a7f8be9f423053ce8caee3f9eecc31df32445fc98d4ccd8365, because the manipulation transaction never executes InvFeed; it only pumps the SushiSwap pair and forces a Keep3r observation. The three earlier attacker transactions with the same entry selector, at blocks 14506187, 14506223 and 14506307, succeeded but made no external call, and the earliest attempt to trigger the borrow, 0xc36330a02f146fa3bfeb612083fa5be70f96a223bdb3873715c9c0124987e8c3 at block 14506307, reverted.
Anchor Oracle.setFeed pointing xINV at this feed is a configuration act and is recorded as context only; the code-age basis is the InvFeed deployment.
